attempted_claim: Fix beta>pi/2 and let Omega_beta subset C^2 be the smooth bounded pseudoconvex Diederich-Fornaess worm with parameter beta (flat Levi-degenerate annulus |log|z_2|^2|<=beta-pi/2). Let P_beta be its Bergman projection. Is P_beta:H^s(Omega_beta)->H^s(Omega_beta) bounded for every 0<=s<pi/(2beta-pi)? In particular, decide boundedness versus unboundedness for the intermediate interval s in [pi/(4beta), pi/(2beta-pi)).
decisive_failure: Full-text evidence limited to extracted text of Barrett 1992 and Harrington survey; visual figures and scanned equations not inspected. Numerical gap check covers only five sample beta values, extended by monotonicity reasoning rather than a formal analytic inequality proof. No independent verification of Liu Diederich-Fornaess index computation was attempted; it is cited via the survey. No partial Sobolev estimate or counterexample construction is claimed.
